selector_semantics.double_star: ** matches zero or more complete path segments or remaining characters
selector_semantics.exact: a selector without metacharacters matches one exact blob path
selector_semantics.exclude_policy: exclude selectors are applied after the include union
selector_semantics.include_policy: union of every selector in a domain
selector_semantics.question: ? matches exactly one character inside one path segment
selector_semantics.star: * matches zero or more characters inside one path segment
selector_semantics.universe: blob entries returned by git ls-tree -r for the annotated accepted tag
selector_semantics.unsupported: character classes, brace expansion, filesystem traversal, and symlink following
